item.title: On the Move - Bourne Community Television
item.description: BTV had the pleasure of working with Falmouth Community TV and Sandwich Community TV at the MassMoves public engagement workshop yesterday, an initiative to create a statewide transportation vision. BTV will be airing the workshop that was held at Mass Maritime on BTV13.

item.title: Bourne TV HD Channel Updates - Bourne Community Television
item.description: Watch our public channel in full HD on Comcast Channel 1072 and our government channel on Comcast Channel 1075 in Bourne. We also provide Closed Captioning services, just turn it on your television and enjoy!

item.title: Bourne TV Holiday Schedule - Bourne Community Television
item.description: BTV celebrates the season and will be closed to studio productions beginning on Monday, December 22 and will return on Monday, January 5. We wish you and yours very merry seasons and the happiest New Year!
